checkpoint.description: Lightning-distilled SDXL checkpoint filename as ComfyUI knows it. MUST be set to a real installed checkpoint before generating.

clip_vision_model.description: CLIP vision model used by IP-Adapter.

comfy_url.description: Base URL of the local ComfyUI server.

ip_adapter_model.description: IP-Adapter model filename for character reference images.

ip_adapter_weight.description: How hard IP-Adapter pulls toward the reference image. ~0.7 is a sane start; 1.0 tends to look stiff.

poll_timeout_seconds.description: How long generate() waits for ComfyUI to finish a prompt.

style_lora.description: Optional style LoRA trigger/name compiled into the positive prompt.
